era5_height_transport: surface pressure transported from ERA5 grid elevation to Loucka 425m; pressure rises on descent
control_filter: same fail-closed predicate applied before predictions, calibration, selection, holdout and annual QC metrics

split.gap_backtest: holdout only; synthetic contiguous masks, target is existing local pressure

quality_control: Controls require usUnits=16, interval_min=5, timestamps on UTC five-minute boundaries, pressure 900-1050 hPa, barometer 930-1080 hPa, outTemp -40..45 C, V1 training domain, and exclusion of every hashed suspected isolated barometer spike. Same filter applied before fit/select/holdout.
